segments.name: Fertility benefits
segments.description: Provides self-insured employer clients and their members with fertility treatment, pharmacy and women's health benefits through a managed specialist network and care advocates.
segments.evidence: Progyny is a benefits management company specializing in fertility, family building and women's health benefits solutions and operates and manages in one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Self-insured employer clients pay for fertility benefits and related care management services delivered to their employees and covered dependents.
revenueModel.evidence: Progyny primarily generates revenue through its fertility benefits solution, in which Progyny provides self-insured enterprise entities ("clients") and their employees and partners (together, "members") with fertility benefits.
